rv.q: What makes 'Prince of Broadway' work so well is that it doesn't try to turn Mr. Prince's career into a conventional biographical narrative but instead uses his shows as stepping stones to explore the changing nature of the Broadway musical.
But this recap of an illustrious career leaves no doubt about the validity of producer-director Harold Prince's exalted status, even if it's thin on illuminating detail.
